new_scholarship.name: UTM International Ambassadorial Scholarship

new_scholarship.program_type: University scholarship requiring a separate application after an admissions offer
new_scholarship.duration: 4 years (Semester 1-8) for engineering, computing and Malaysia-Japan International Institute of Technology programmes; 3 years (Semester 1-6) for Architecture and Management/Marketing; 3-4 years for other fields, with one to three short semesters added for some programmes
new_scholarship.deadline: UTM's official wording for the September 2026 intake, international undergraduate: 'Phase 1 Date of application: 1 April 2026 - 15 May 2026' and 'Phase 2 Date of application: 23 June 2026 - 17 July 2026'. Applications 'must be apply via UTM Application system SMARt'. Both phases are closed, and the UTM International Ambassadorial Scholarship application form states 'This form is currently closed for submissions.'
new_scholarship.application_period: September 2026 intake: Phase 1, 1 April 2026 - 15 May 2026 and Phase 2, 23 June 2026 - 17 July 2026, both closed. Next expected cycle is the September 2027 intake, with a Phase 1 opening historically in early April.
new_scholarship.application_method: Separate application, not automatic on admission. Applicants first apply for admission to a full-time international undergraduate programme through the UTM-SMARt admission system at smart.utm.my/admission during an open intake phase. UTM states that an applicant 'can only apply for a scholarship once you have applied for admission for a place on the course you wish to study and been offered' and that 'We cannot accept any scholarship application without an admissions offer.' Only after receiving the offer are all three sections of the UTM International Ambassadorial Scholarship application form completed on admission.utm.my; submitting the form constitutes agreement to UTM's scholarship terms.
new_scholarship.description: The UTM International Ambassadorial Scholarship is the only named institutional award that Universiti Teknologi Malaysia publishes for international students. UTM states that a scholarship application is only accepted after the applicant has applied for admission to the course they wish to study and been offered a place, and the application form has three sections whose submission constitutes agreement to UTM's scholarship terms. As of 2026-10-03 the four supplementary Ambassadorial Scholarship pages on admission.utm.my no longer publish the scheme's benefit, eligibility or window details, and the application form page states it is closed for submissions.
new_scholarship.best_fit: An international (non-Malaysian) secondary-school leaver who has already applied to a full-time UTM undergraduate programme and received an offer, holds a Senior High School Certificate or equivalent that clears UTM's country-specific threshold, meets the English requirement with a test result valid within two years, and can fund the full published international tuition plus the Immigration-set Personal Bond in case no waiver is granted.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Open to international (non-Malaysian) students who already hold an admissions offer from UTM for the course applied for. Admission requires a Senior High School Certificate or equivalent pre-university qualification assessed against country-specific minimum grades (for example Bangladesh HSC grade A+ in Mathematics and Physics for Engineering, Australian Year 12 grade B or 70% ATAR for Electrical Engineering and grade C or 60% ATAR for other fields, Albanian Matura 7/10, Algerian Baccalaureat 14/20, Afghan Baccalauria 80%, Cameroonian and Botswana GCE A Level grade B, Canadian Grade 12 grade B, Brunei Cambridge GCE A Level grade B), plus faculty-specific requirements and a UTM interview for Bachelor of Architecture and Bachelor of Science Industrial Design. English requirement for all programmes except TESL: MUET Band 4.0, IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 46, PTE Academic 51, Cambridge English Qualification 160, or ELS Certified Intensive English Programme Level 108; TESL requires MUET Band 5.0, IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 79, PTE 63 and CEQ 176; results valid two years only. No age limit, gender restriction or nationality quota is published. UTM does not publish the scholarship's own academic threshold, selection criteria or benefit amount.

research_notes.logo: Hunt order followed. First I probed the awarding body's main site, https://www.utm.my/, and found its header logo asset https://www.utm.my/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/LOGO-UTM-MAIN-2025.png (HTTP 200, image/png, 55,058 bytes). I downloaded and analysed it: 1605x447 Format32bppArgb, 63.0 percent of opaque pixels white and 0 percent dark, which is a white-on-transparent wordmark. Repo rule 6 deliberately excludes white-on-transparent wordmarks because they are invisible on a light card, so this asset was rejected rather than shipped. I then probed candidate dark or full-colour variants of the same logo on www.utm.my (LOGO-UTM-MAIN-2025-dark.png, LOGO-UTM-MAIN-2025-DARK.png, LOGO-UTM-MAIN-2025-black.png, LOGO-UTM-MAIN-dark.png, LOGO-UTM-MAIN.png, LOGO-UTM.png, UTM-logo-dark.png, Logo-UTM-2025.png) and all returned failure. I then probed other official utm.my domains and found https://digital.utm.my/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/cropped-UTM-LOGO.png, referenced in the digital.utm.my homepage header markup and used as that page's og:image. It returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type image/png and 233,374 bytes, is 512x512 Format32bppArgb, and its dominant colours are maroon RGB(93,0,29) and gold RGB(230,147,5) on transparency with 0 percent white and 0 percent dark pixels, confirming a full-colour UTM mark rather than a white wordmark. Because digital.utm.my is a utm.my domain operated by UTM (UTMDigital, Office of Quality and Digital Transformation) and the logo is UTM's own institutional mark, provenance is correct and official_host is true with host_evidence same_registrable_domain. No third-party, aggregator, CDN, social or stock host was used. I also verified the alternative https://admission.utm.my/wp-content/uploads/sites/461/2022/03/LOGO-ADMISSION.png (HTTP 200, image/png, 84,657 bytes, 2038x447, full colour), but that is the Admission division logo rather than UTM's institutional mark, so it was not used. official_logo_overrides.json has no existing utm.my key, so this entry is new rather than a duplicate.

research_notes.degree_level_confirmed: The award funds a bachelor's degree. UTM's undergraduate entry requirement is 'A Senior High School Certificate or equivalent pre - university qualifications' together with the English proficiency requirement and, where applicable, a faculty interview, and the international undergraduate fee table is organised in 'Semester 1 - 8' and 'Semester 1 - 6' tuition instalments for bachelor's programmes, all of which are bachelor's-level structures. The registration kit is headed 'eRegistration KIT / International Undergraduate' and lists Semester I 2026/2027 briefing and course registration by faculty for named bachelor's programmes. Note the caveat recorded in unverified_or_removed_claims: UTM's Ambassadorial Scholarship pages do not themselves state a level restriction, so the bachelor's framing is inferred from the scheme's placement in the international undergraduate admission area of admission.utm.my and from the research target, and should be confirmed with UTM.
